title: dm_query_json request
description: A bulk question about the object tree. Frozen at ABI 0.11 and versioned separately from the binary: new queries and new optional members are additive, and anything removed or renamed is a major bump. Unknown members are ignored by the library, so a client written against a later schema still gets an answer from an older build. ancestorsOf and references arrived at 0.14, overriddenProc at 0.31.

path.description: The type path to answer about. "/" and "" both mean the root. For references it is the SYMBOL: dm_definition_at's detail spelling - "/mob/hp" for a var, "/mob/heal()" for a proc, "/heal()" for a global, a type's path for a type - canonicalised to the farthest declaring type, which is the LAST hit dm_definition_at returns.

name.description: overriddenProc only. The proc whose override chain is asked about, as a bare name - "Login", not "/mob/Login()". Required there; an empty name is DM_ERR_NOT_FOUND.

depth.description: objectTree only. Levels of children to include: 1 is one level, which is what a panel needs for a node the user just expanded; 0 is the node alone, for a single-row refresh.

limit.description: subtypesOf and references. Cap on how many types or hits come back. A response that hit the cap sets "truncated". Defaults to 500 for subtypesOf and 1000 for references.

encoding.description: references only. The unit for startChar/endChar in each hit, since dm_query_json has no encoding parameter of its own. Anything other than "utf8" is read as "utf16".

inherited.description: members only. Include what the type inherits, walking parent_type rather than the path.

includeBuiltins.description: Include BYOND's own types and members alongside the project's.
